assessment.diagnostic_gap: Old positive bound_operation asserts exit0/ACK/empty errors and then output oracle without persisting exit/ACK/markers/diagnostic; finally only calls active.close. This directly demonstrates the observability gap, not the actual SQL failure cause. New partial safe record before capture/terminal assertion is appropriate.
assessment.minimal_fields: Finite grant-template/login/current stage/source SQL SHA; strict exit int-or-null, ACK bool-or-null, bounded counts/shapes and exact source-known marker presence/order/comparison booleans. No stdout/rowJSON, raw backend tuple, grant rows/tokens, SQL text, args or arbitrary expected values. Unknown/malformed values stop.
assessment.source_metadata: Use source_metadata through existing admitted helper graph. Declaration/source5ae equality and closed enums/keys/types/body/function/column associations in mandatory addendum prevent unsafe helper dictionaries or drift. No new unchecked import or raw metadata. Bound text/line/field sizes before sanitizer; overlarge/control/multiple-header/unknown cases produce fixed redaction and never a guard proof.
assessment.verdict_separation: All unexpected metadata labeled UNEXPECTED_NOT_GUARD_PROOF. Preserve existing positive commit/marker/JSON predicates and exact negative binder diagnostic predicate. SQLSTATE/source frame metadata cannot convert failure into successful intended guard or qualify any case.
assessment.close_order: Finally must attempt affected Session.close even if capture/result/metadata/save fails, marking operation_closed only after confirmation. Always attempt required all-client closure before terminal/qualification observers; safety closure observations and existing independently committed issuer/live-tuple witness are not removed. Preserve first original failure with later close/global/IO failures secondary; no further ordinary behavior under uncertainty.
assessment.IO_and_cleanup: Source-aware actual Core.initialize/launch/WorkerSession boundary mocks must exercise persistent writes/events and actual close/global/finalizer/exact3C2V+private archive cleanup composition, not stub all safety functions. No successful outcome from diagnostics persistence or clean poststate after earlier failure.
assessment.test_oracle: Old-bound_operation restoration must lose required partial evidence and fail. Model actual Session finish returns/errors, emitted source markers and positive/negative result predicates. Canary strings through stderr/context/args/stdout/rowJSON/helper returns/exception strings, malformed/oversize fields, declaration/source drift, wrong function/bodySHA/line/column and multiple/unknown headers must never cross output and must stop later behavior.
assessment.gates: New own-source review gates remain PENDING; prior exact-layer source approvals are historical only. Separate source review/offline proof, published complete current+committed packet and fresh exact literal review are needed; no retry of old unchanged attempt.

plain_english: The plan adds a small safe report when a test fails. It records check marks and known error codes, not passwords or database rows. It does not change which tests pass or guess why the old test failed.
